output.reason: [ev-09d5e26554e5] limits the requirement to Cilium running with `--datapath-mode=lb-only` in plain Docker mode. In that case, leaving out `--enable-k8s=false` makes Cilium assume Kubernetes is present. The proposed condition omits the plain-Docker qualifier, so it also flags lb-only deployments that really run on Kubernetes, where assuming Kubernetes is correct. That makes it too broad. No static input shows plain-Docker operation, so it is added as an undecidable operand. The value literal is also corrected from a quoted string to lb-only, and environments that already set `--enable-k8s=false` are listed as overlap.

correction.statement: Cilium running with --datapath-mode=lb-only in plain Docker mode (without Kubernetes) and without --enable-k8s=false now assumes Kubernetes is present. Setting --enable-k8s=false explicitly avoids this.

of.needed: whether Cilium is operated in plain Docker mode without Kubernetes rather than inside a Kubernetes cluster
